scope: Personal isolated PostgreSQL/POSIX-file concurrency and actual Pod/HTTPS recovery verification; not operational continuity qualification
limitations: Original 500/422/timeout incidents are retained; deterministic reproduction of a mechanism is not retrospective proof that every earlier incident had that cause
Each runtime case is one closed-loop local realization; retry changes offered arrival timing; no causal/statistical improvement estimate
POSIX local-file locks do not provide WORM retention, tail truncation detection, malicious inode replacement protection or multi-host consensus
SQL and external witness commits are not atomic; a genuine rollback remains blocked pending explicit recovery
Snapshot/IdP/bootstrap keys/file witness/shared DB client certificate and single node/server are qualification fixtures, not enterprise identity or cloud deployment
The 2-second fixture DB connect timeout and 15-second evidence collection wait are not production SLOs; no limits were relaxed to erase failures

post_measurement_changes.change: Remove the unused time import only; no test predicate, timeout or runtime logic change
